info.title: LISA External API
info.description: Versioned contract for the REST and SSE surfaces shared by the TypeScript server and native clients. Version 1 preserves the existing response bodies; additive optional fields are backwards compatible.

200.description: Normalized sessions from every enabled observer.
Retained LISA-owned dispatches.
One retained dispatch plus its bounded output tail.
Lightweight current LISA state.
Newline-delimited SSE data frames. Unknown event types and additive fields must be ignored.
Chat events using the shared SSE event envelope.
Lisa's own chat sessions on disk, newest first (PLAN_UI_SESSION_SHELL_v1.1). The on-disk file path is server-internal and never serialized.
Creates a fresh Lisa session and makes it the active web session.
Switches the active web session to an existing one.

The caller's reach-out controls (docs/POLICY_REACH_OUT.md): proactivity dial, per-source switches, quiet hours, channels, plus today's unsolicited budget. Scoped to the signed-in account in the cloud edition.
Merges the patch over the stored settings and returns the new view. Unknown fields and invalid values are rejected, not ignored.
Aggregates of the reach-out ledger for the last N local days: delivered / deferred / dropped per source and the useful rate. Never returns ledger rows or any message text.
Records the user's verdict on a delivered notice. Feeds the value gate: dismissed kinds push less.
Every task of the signed-in account, oldest first.

get.description: MEMORY.md and USER.md parsed into entries with content-addressed ids. Cloud: account session required; the signed-in tenant's memory only.

200.description: Both memory stores.

post.description: Append a bullet entry. Mac: loopback owner or account session; cloud: account session.

put.description: Replace one entry's text. An id whose entry changed meanwhile no longer resolves (404).

200.description: The updated entry (its id changes with its text).
The entry was removed.

post.description: Forget a topic across memory, KB, sessions, search indexes, relationships and (literal redactions only) Lisa's journal. The topic matches as whole words, case-insensitive (exact character sequence for scripts without spaces, see report.match). dryRun: true previews every item that would change, each with an id and a short snippet of the text around the match, plus a digest. Apply by sending the same query with that digest; the server re-plans and answers 409 preview_changed unless the set is exactly the previewed one. An applied report carries no content.

200.description: What was (or would be) forgotten, plus honest residuals.

get.description: Download the caller's Lisa as a gzip'd tar (soul, MEMORY.md, USER.md, kb, skills, tasks, optional sessions) with manifest.json last. Never contains secrets, keys, accounts, devices, billing, warden/ or task leases/locks/outbox. Cloud: the signed-in tenant only; Mac: loopback owner only.

200.description: The archive (Content-Disposition: attachment).

ApiVersion.description: Major protocol version of this response.

error.description: Stable machine-readable code in most v1 routes; a few legacy routes still return a short message.

status.description: running | ok (observed exit 0) | failed (non-zero exit or signal) | unknown (not alive, no exit observed). `alive: false` alone does not mean success: the child is detached, so a crash, an OOM kill and a clean finish are indistinguishable from the pid.

exitCode.description: Observed exit code. null when the process died by signal; absent when no exit was ever observed.

exitSignal.description: Signal name when the process died by signal.

SSEEvent.description: Open event envelope. Clients must ignore unknown types and additive fields; known v1 types include agent_session_update, claude_session_update, mood, chat_start, chat_delta, chat_end, idle_message, advisor_suggestions, screen_suggestion, sense_event, reflect_done, approval_requested, approval_resolved, task_updated, task_deleted, task_run_started, task_run_finished, task_result and error.

ReachOutSettingsPatch.description: Any subset of ReachOutSettings; nested objects are merged field by field.

expr.description: at:<ISO-8601> | every:<n>(m|h|d) | daily:HH:MM | weekdays:HH:MM | weekly:<mon..sun>@HH:MM | cron:<m h dom mon dow>

tz.description: IANA time zone; the host's zone when omitted.

pausedReason.description: Why the engine switched the task off by itself. Cleared when the user enables it.

resumeAt.description: The active run is parked after a failed attempt and resumes (same run) at this time.

tokens.description: Tokens processed. The run's token budget is measured against the sum of all four.

sideEffects.description: How many state-changing calls the run recorded.

type.description: tool_call | tool_result | replayed | denied | info | error | resume

id.description: Stable notice id; a client that has shown it must not show it again.

text.description: The card as stored in the conversation.

from.description: Always "Lisa" — the reach-out gate stamps every proactive message.

reachOutId.description: Reach-out ledger id; pass it to POST /api/reachout/feedback. The gate also emits an idle_message (source task|watcher) carrying the same id.

TaskResultEvent.description: A task result the reach-out gate let through. The same result is stored as a card in the conversation.

kind.description: approval or handoff. A handoff cannot be approved, only dismissed.

category.description: Open set; v1 values: read, self, draft, write, exec, network, send, publish, purchase, delete, credential.

preview.description: Redacted rendering of the payload, at most 240 characters.

digest.description: HMAC of the exact payload this approval is bound to (per-home key).

items.description: Open set; v1 values: once, task, target, 24h, always.

scopes.description: Scopes this item may be approved with.

canApprove.description: Whether this caller is a trusted approver.

digest.description: The digest of the payload the approver was shown (from GET /api/approvals/{id}). Required; a missing or stale digest is refused.

scope.description: Open set; v1 values: once, task, target, 24h, always.

additionalProperties.description: Open set; v1 values: auto, preapproved, ask, handoff.

value.description: The whole value, secrets masked, never clipped.

primary.description: Shown first: the field that says what the call does.

fields.description: Every field of the tool input, in the server's order (primary fields first).

corrupt.description: Not clean UTF-8; edits are refused (409) until repaired.

dryRun.description: true previews; anything else applies and needs digest.

digest.description: The digest of the confirmed preview. Required to apply.

id.description: Stable item id; apply changes only previewed ids.

location.description: Home-relative path; memory entries as path#id, transcript and soul-file lines as path:line.

snippet.description: Dry run only: about 80 characters of text around the first match.

why.description: Why this action, e.g. title, tag, file name.

digest.description: Digest of the previewed item ids; pass back to apply.

counts.description: Matches per layer: memory, user, kb, memory_kb_links, sessions, reflections, search_index, relationships, journal.

remaining.description: Matches per layer: memory, user, kb, memory_kb_links, sessions, reflections, search_index, relationships, journal.
